title: `GoogleModel` never sets `include_server_side_tool_invocations` for `CodeExecutionTool`, so code execution can't be combined with function tools on Gemini 3
author: gmetzker

comments.author: pydanty[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- pydanty:status-comment:v1 -->

## pydanty status: bug

**Classification:** bug

**Why this matters:** Users combining CodeExecutionTool with function tools on Gemini 3 models hit an HTTP 400 from the Google API because GoogleModel never sets include_server_side_tool_invocations for CodeExecutionTool. This blocks a core use case — mixing code execution with custom tools — on the latest Gemini models. The fix unblocks this combination and is gated by a profile flag so older models are unaffected.

**Evidence summary:** Reproducer confirmed via code inspection: google.py:718-720 checks only (WebSearchTool, WebFetchTool, FileSearchTool) in the isinstance guard for include_server_side_tool_invocations; CodeExecutionTool is imported (line 44) and converted to ToolDict (line 649) but excluded from the flag. Existing tests in test_tool_choice_unit.py cover only WebSearchTool. Repositorian confirmed PR #4848 introduced this logic and the exclusion was based on a comment that CodeExecutionTool uses its own parts, but the Gemini API requires the flag for any built-in tool + function calling combination. Reporter's subclass workaround works on gemini-3.1-pro-preview. No maintainer explicitly defended the exclusion.

**Playground:** null

**Next action:** pr_ready -- Reproduced, localized one-line fix with clear checked-in code preference; no maintainer design decision needed.

GoogleModel._get_tool_config omits CodeExecutionTool from the isinstance check that gates include_server_side_tool_invocations, causing HTTP 400 when combining code execution with function tools on Gemini 3. Fix: add CodeExecutionTool to the isinstance tuple, update the comment, and add a regression test. The fix is gated on the google_supports_server_side_tool_invocations profile flag so older models are unaffected.
